depcache.what: shared dependency cache: restore dependency rlibs instead of compiling
depcache.note: fresh target dir (a new checkout, worktree, or slot); the cache was filled by one earlier build

build-script-cache.what: replay registry build-script runs (OUT_DIR + output) instead of running them
build-script-cache.note: fresh target dir with the depcache warm in both variants

feature-unify.what: resolve dependency features once per workspace, so -p switches reuse builds
feature-unify.note: fresh target dir, depcache off, three `check -p` in a row (the switch cost without caches hiding it)

slots.what: per-agent target dirs: a second agent does not wait on the first one's build lock
slots.note: agent A runs `build -p jcode-desktop-ui` after a ui-core body edit; agent B starts 1s later with the reference loop (test-fn edit, `test --lib -- fps_counter`); B's wall is measured

parallel-frontend.what: rustc -Zthreads=8 for local crates (Desktop's rustc wrapper)

parallel-frontend-deep.what: same, on the worst warm case (jcode-core body edit, 16 crates rebuilt)

mold.what: mold linker instead of the system cc/ld (Desktop's fast-linker)
